text:
rachel: beginning canary rollout for release v4.1.0 in change-window (US & EU). watch dashboards for tenant-level SLOs (p95/p99 and 5xx).
deploy-bot: rollout initiated: release=v4.1.0 stage=canary regions=us,eu initial=2% user=rachel
sam: I'm on embeds & rerank panels. will flag anything >0.4% 5xx or p99 > 500ms.
billy: preflight checks OK. synthetic runners scheduled for mixed payload shapes.
monitor-bot: alert: embeddings.create 5xx_rate=0.9% (threshold=0.4%) region=eu-west tenant=BetaApps window=1m rule=tenant-5xx-sentinel
rachel: saw that. it's tenant=BetaApps only. do we have tenant routing for this service?
sam: yes. prefer tenant-level pin to limit blast radius. running: `routectl set --service embeddings.create --tenant BetaApps --version v4.0.7 --region eu-west`
deploy-bot: action executed: tenant_pin tenant=BetaApps service=embeddings.create old=v4.1.0 new=v4.0.7 by=sam status=success
billy: after pin, 5xx dropped to 0.06% within 45s. logs show NullPointer in normalization path for large attachments.
monitor-bot: info: overall service error rate normalized. global SLO holding.
cs: pinged Support to inform BetaApps; drafting a short message: "We've routed your traffic to a stable version during investigation."
rachel: good. keep v4.1.0 paused for embeddings.create. we should autoticket and add to changelog: paused due to tenant-level canary 5xx spike.
sam: creating bug: RELEASE-6012. assigning @billy. adding sample request and stacktrace.
billy: will add a quick guard and reduce allocation for normalization queue, then redeploy canary for only BetaApps at 0.5% with synthetic hits.
rachel: checklist for re-run: 1) guard deployed to canary image 2) synthetic run 10m against BetaApps 3) target p99<480ms and 5xx<0.2% before progressive ramp 4) update release notes and CS message
monitor-bot: note: change-window ends in 22m. if still paused at window end, we will keep the hold and schedule next attempt in the off-window.
sam: ack. I'll coordinate with infra if we need a weekend off-window.
rachel: thanks. closing thread until the synthetic completes. reopen if any new alerts.
deploy-bot: rollout paused: component=embeddings.create scope=tenant BetaApps reason=tenant-5xx-sentinel user=rachel
